claims_rejected.why: illustrated, not stated: the narrator says the king lost at the sight and lost his life at her words (கண்டளவே தோற்றான் ... உண்டளவே தோற்றான் உயிர்), a scene, not a general claim

claims.gist: consciousness arises from the combined elements as intoxication arises from mixing தாதகிப் பூ and jaggery
consciousness perishes when the elements separate, as a drum's sound dies away
elements with consciousness and without it each give rise to beings by their own kind; this is the true account
only perception (கண்கூடு) is a means of knowing; inference (கருத்து அளவு) fails
this life and its fruit are in this birth alone; a next world where deeds are reaped is false

claims_rejected.why: வேறு உரை விகற்பமும் is a dismissal of other views folded into the same doctrine, not a separate claim

units.note: The refutation (inference needed to know one's parents) falls at 284-287, outside this unit; stance taken from it.

claims.gist: the whole world is an egg laid by one god

claims.school_detail: reciter of the purana of the sea-coloured one
claims.gist: Narayana is the protection (of the world)

claims.school_detail: வேதியன; Veda with its six angas
claims.gist: the Veda, with kalpa, chandas, jyotisha, nirukta, siksha and vyakarana as its limbs, has no beginning or end and is not born of dependence; it is the path
none of these speakers' words agree with true reasoning in any way

units.note: Line 106-107 is Manimekalai's verdict on all three views, which is what makes them refuted rather than reported.

claims_rejected.why: illustrated, not stated: Neelakesi's mind turned after she took the great one's dharma (பெரியோனறங் கொண்ட பின்னை) and she cleared wrong from the world; a narrative summary, no general claim

claims.gist: the saying of the learned that dharma becomes death to those who do wrong is not false

claims_rejected.why: the queen's self-reference as one of harsh deeds (கடுவினையேன்) is lament, not a doctrinal claim about karma

units.note: The saying is set off (என்னும் பல்லவையோர் சொல்லும்) but matches no Kural or Naladiyar wording I can name, so it is not an echo.

claims.gist: one knows one's own father and mother only by inference, so inference is a means of knowing
without true understanding the true object is hard to know; the materialist's position amounts to doubt

claims_rejected.why: narration that she learned the five schools, no claim

units.note: School could be read as buddhist given the work, but the text presents it as Manimekalai's argument, not as a school's doctrine.

claims.gist: earth is hard and sinks, water is cold with taste and flows down, fire burns and rises, wind moves sideways
the atoms are beginningless and indestructible, are not newly born, do not enter one another, do not change kind, do not split or spread
atoms move, sink and rise, combine into mountains, bamboo, sprouts and the earth, and separate again into their own natures
an element is named by the atom that predominates in the mixture (one, three-quarters, half, quarter)

units.note: The dismissal (சொல் தடுமாற்றத் தொடர்ச்சியை விட்டு, 166) falls outside the unit; stance taken from it.

claims.school_detail: the Pandya's claim, reversed by the anklet scene and his own words at 85
claims.gist: killing a thief is not a cruel sceptre but the triumph of the spear
a king who heeds a goldsmith's word is himself the thief; when guarding the people fails through him, his life should end
there is nothing to offer those who have lost their husband (a widow has no consolation)

claims_rejected.why: the lowered umbrella and bent sceptre are illustrated, not stated

units.note: Line 74 is refuted by the scene and the king's confession rather than by argument.

claims.gist: the lord worshipped by the good is free of birth and the other three (பிறப்பு ஆதி நான்கு)
his word removes the suffering of beings and makes it bliss; he is the light of dharma
the omniscient one (எல்லாம் உணர்ந்தான்) alone is to be praised as God
gain, loss, obstacle, arrival, pleasure, pain, birth and death are mixed in at conception
pleasure and pain too are to be counted as atoms
prior destiny (முன் உள ஊழ்) alone brings about what follows

claims_rejected.why: a question to the நிகண்டவாதி, not a claim

units.note: Stance rests on சொல் தடுமாற்றத் தொடர்ச்சியை விட்டு (166), a dismissal rather than an argued answer.

claims.gist: purusha is not of the three gunas nor the ground of things, but consciousness that knows all things, one, all-pervading and eternal
there are twenty-five principles: five elements, five sense organs, five sense objects, five organs of action, mind, intellect, ego, citta, and the soul

units.note: The Sankhya teacher is heard and passed over (செயிர் அறச் செப்பிய திறமும் கேட்டு) with no answer in or near the unit, so reported.

claims.gist: even the white moon the world loves is not without stain; nothing is flawless

claims_rejected.why: the poet's request not to call all his words virtue is a modesty formula, not a doctrinal claim

units.note: The moon's stain recalls Kural 957 in idea only; no four-word run is shared.

claims.gist: there are eight fallacies of knowing (pramana-abhasa): bare apprehension, misapprehension, doubt, unexamined certainty, non-apprehension, verbal fiction, re-cognition and memory, each defined with an example
the six schools (Lokayata, Buddhist, Sankhya, Nyaya, Vaisheshika, Mimamsa) have as teachers Brihaspati, Jina, Kapila, Akshapada, Kanada and Jaimini
the means of knowing now in use are perception, inference, testimony, analogy, presumption and non-existence

claims_rejected.why: the shell taken for silver is an example within the definition, not a separate claim

units.note: Line 86 only says she left him, so the pramana teacher's account is reported, not refuted.
